test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All Wolves are Rhinoceroses.

No Rhinoceroses are Kangaroos.

Conclusions:

I: No Kangaroos are Wolves.

II: Some Kangaroos are Wolves.
solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24a47992a87e9274ba88c5ba82e30b43ed68fa6ab62b3dda1b57e2f6d31bc533.png] 

Conclusions:**
I: No Kangaroos are Wolves. - True (No Rhinoceroses are Kangaroos. All Wolves are Rhinoceroses.)

II: Some Kangaroos are Wolves. - False ( As their is no direct relation between Kangaroos and Wolves, may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**
